messages:
incident-bot: [PAGER] High error-rate detected on /v1/stream — 5xx spike (gateway + upstream) observed across us-west-2. 97% 5xx over 5m, p50 latency increased. Paging @oncall.

Samir.k: ack, I'm on it. I can already see lots of 502/504 from gateway. Quick grep shows repeated 'client aborted chunked encoding' and upstream 'net/http: request canceled'.

Anya.devex: any customer reports yet? CS?

maria-cs: AcmeCorp reported multiple streaming disconnects ~5m ago, they say sessions cut mid-stream. I'm drafting a short note.

Lee-sre: tailing gateway logs now — nginx shows 'upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response' and a bunch of 'client canceled' lines. Also noting a dedicated pool autoscaler event ~5m ago that coincides with the spike.

Jordan-eng: was there a recent deploy? deploy-bot?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment 2027-03-15T12:03:00Z model-proxy-prod-us-west succeeded -> image: model-proxy:v3.11. (link)

Samir.k: repro attempt with curl: 
```bash
curl -N -v 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}'
# client receives a few chunks then connection reset
```

Samir.k: gateway excerpt: 
```
[error] 12345#0: *98765 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.0.1, server: api, request: "POST /v1/stream HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.3.4:8080/", host: "api.redwood.ai"
```

Anya.devex: initial mitigation ideas: 1) fail traffic to legacy-proxy that has more conservative keepalive/timeout handling 2) temporarily increase proxy_read_timeout/proxy_send_timeout 3) reduce streaming chunk size (or switch heavy customers to polling) 4) roll back proxy deploy if regression confirmed.

Lee-sre: I can flip a fallback route quickly. Will set small percentage shift to legacy-proxy first. Doing now.

Samir.k: applying traffic shift 5% -> legacy-proxy for us-west: 
```
rbctl route set --service stream --region us-west --policy fallback=legacy-proxy --percent 5
```

ops-bot: traffic-shift: 5% traffic to legacy-proxy applied by samir.k.

Jordan-eng: also seeing model-proxy pods with elevated memory and a few restarts; might be a connection leak or blocked goroutines after the deploy.

maria-cs: AcmeCorp metrics: ~40% of active sessions experienced at least one disconnect in the last 10m. I'm sending them a status update now — will mention we're routing to fallback and applying timeouts.

Samir.k: quick config mitigation — bump nginx proxy_read_timeout 30s -> 90s in gateway configmap, then do rolling restart of gateway pods. Pushing patch.

ops-bot: configmap update committed by samir.k. Rolling restart job started (1 pod at a time).

Lee-sre: monitoring dashboards: after 5% shift + timeout bump, 5xx dropped from 97% -> ~22% within 3m. p50 latency improved from 650ms -> 210ms.

Anya.devex: good progress. Who's staying on for monitoring / handoff?

Lee-sre: I'll maintain watch for 30m and then hand off to Samir for overnight.

Samir.k: taking overnight. Escalation criteria: if >10% 5xx sustained for 15m, wake eng-sre pager. Also will open an incident doc and gather logs.

Anya.devex: agreed. Postmortem outline to include timeline, root-cause hypothesis (model-proxy v3.11 change + keepalive/timeouts regress + autoscaler churn), customer impact numbers, and follow-ups: add canary traffic check that exercises streaming, add alert for chunked-connection-reset rate, add automated timeout gating for streaming deploys.

maria-cs: update to AcmeCorp sent: "We've routed a portion of your traffic to a fallback proxy and increased timeouts to reduce disconnects; engineering is investigating root cause. We will follow up with a full update." :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 by Anya.devex.

Lee-sre: handing off monitoring to Samir.k at 13:48 UTC. Logs to reference: /var/log/gateway/*.log, gateway dash: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/gateway/streaming-errors (internal).

Samir.k: ack taking over. I'll assemble logs and open the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/2070001111 (placeholder).

Anya.devex: nice work everyone. Please add any additional notes to the incident doc. We'll follow up with RCA and customer communication. :thumbsup:
